programs.title: Alphablocks
programs.desc: The Alphablocks have fun naming their hens and, finally, their helper, BEN the pen!

programs.title: Gardening Australia Junior
programs.desc: Costa, Yeshi and Owen visit a community nursery and an idea starts to grow! They build a community seed library, so everyone can share and replant local species for years to come.

programs.title: History Hunters
programs.desc: Our hosts try out some Renaissance painting techniques and create their own version of the Mona Lisa, plus working out how springs can help tell the time. Also, see how Renaissance astrologers turned their eyes to the skies.

programs.title: Horrible Histories
programs.desc: From camels to space rockets, via Dandy Horses, actual horses, royal train rides, cars, balloons and planes, we look at the history of getting around.

programs.title: Bushrangers
programs.desc: The majority of Australia's first bushrangers were convicts who escaped harsh punishment working in chain gangs or penal stations. When these convicts escaped, they had to find a way to survive in the Australian bush.

programs.title: btn
programs.desc: BTN is a high-energy, fun way for Upper Primary and Secondary students to learn about current issues and events in their world. Each program is built around major news stories of the week.
